the study of ABA metabolism in tomato.
the study of abscisic Acid (ABA) and its role in plant responses to environmental stresses such as drought, cold and high salinity.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
LeNCED is the notabilis gene and that the notabilis mutation is a null allele, but that the wild-type phenotype cannot be fully recreated in a single line.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the LeNCED1 promoter contains cis elements that confer ABA and drought inducibility and that the ABA-deficient phenotype of the not mutant can be rescued by transfer of a LeNCED1 genomic clone.

partial complementation can be used as a tool to study the role and action of ABA in plants, and to study the promoter of ABA-related genes.
